boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, documented academic environments at Sewanee, spanning library collaboration, quiet reading, presentation practice, and discipline-specific computing.

cards.title: Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Main floor, Jessie Ball duPont Library
cards.notes: Set up at a Media:scape table or a powered work surface when your work calls for shared screens, devices, and a collaborative library setting.
cards.short_summary: A renovated duPont Library area with contemporary computer technology, Media:scape tables, and power outlets.
cards.evidence_claim: Sewanee describes the Learning Commons as offering state-of-the-art computer technology, Media:scape tables, and multiple power outlets.
cards.source_title: Penny Cowan, P'09, P'12, Enriches Sewanee with Employee Support
cards.access_notes: Located on the main floor of Jessie Ball duPont Library; confirm current library access before visiting.

cards.title: Learning Commons Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Main floor, Jessie Ball duPont Library
cards.notes: Reserve a group room when you need a dedicated setting for shared coursework; use the university’s room guidance to plan the session.
cards.short_summary: Bookable group-study rooms within duPont Library’s main-floor Learning Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: The university catalog states that the Learning Commons offers group study rooms that can be reserved for student use.
cards.access_notes: Student use requires reservation; consult current Practice and Study Rooms guidance for availability and rules.

cards.entity_name: Center for Speaking & Listening Open Work Space
cards.title: Center for Speaking & Listening Open Work Space
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons, Jessie Ball duPont Library
cards.notes: Bring a presentation, interview, debate, or language project and use the tables, chairs, and outlets to prepare with a partner or team.
cards.short_summary: An open preparation area designed for speaking-and-listening projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The Center for Speaking & Listening has open work space with tables, chairs, and outlets for academic speaking and listening projects.
cards.access_notes: On duPont Library’s main floor in the Learning Commons, next to Cup & Gown Café.

cards.entity_name: Center for Speaking & Listening Practice Rooms
cards.title: Center for Speaking & Listening Practice Rooms
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons, Jessie Ball duPont Library
cards.notes: Use a semi-private practice room to rehearse a presentation or review a recording; reserve it first when you need a contained setup.
cards.short_summary: Four technology-equipped, semi-private rooms for rehearsal and collaborative practice.
cards.evidence_claim: The Center for Speaking & Listening provides four semi-private practice rooms for collaboration, meetings, rehearsal, and viewing practice recordings.
cards.source_title: Resources for Students | Center for Speaking & Listening
cards.access_notes: Practice rooms are in the shared Center for Speaking & Listening and Writing Center space; current room guidance covers reservations.

cards.title: Harrison Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Ralston Listening Library, duPont Library
cards.notes: Choose this reading room for book-and-score work in a music-library setting, and check duPont Library access conditions before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A reading room framed by the Ralston Library’s music-book and score collection.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says the Harrison Reading Room is flanked by the Ralston Library’s music books and score collection and serves as a campus study space.
cards.access_notes: Access is tied to duPont Library hours; consult the library’s current schedule.

cards.title: Ralston Headphone Listening Room
cards.subtitle: Ralston Listening Library, duPont Library
cards.notes: Use the headphone room when careful, private listening belongs alongside your coursework; the room includes a turntable and CD players.
cards.short_summary: A private-listening environment within the Ralston Listening Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ralston Library’s headphone listening room lets patrons listen privately using a turntable and CD players during duPont Library hours.
cards.access_notes: Available during duPont Library hours; confirm current access and equipment-use expectations with the library.

cards.title: Carlson Listening Room
cards.subtitle: Ralston Listening Library, duPont Library
cards.notes: Plan an audio-focused study break or listening assignment here, then check the Ralston calendar for posted listening hours and programs.
cards.short_summary: A high-fidelity listening room with access to lossless digital streaming.
cards.evidence_claim: The Carlson Listening Room has access to high-fidelity digital streaming through Qobuz and TIDAL via Audirvāna.
cards.access_notes: The Ralston Library posts listening hours and notes that appointments are needed outside publicly advertised hours.

cards.title: Main Lab (WL 136)
cards.subtitle: Woods Laboratory, Room 136
cards.notes: Use the main computer-science lab for independent technical work when its desktop workstations and large displays fit the assignment.
cards.short_summary: A computer-science work space with 20 HP desktop computers and 27-inch displays.
cards.evidence_claim: Sewanee identifies Woods Laboratory 136 as a computer-science lab with 20 HP desktop computers and 27-inch monitors.
cards.access_notes: A Computer Science Program space; verify current lab access and any course-related restrictions before use.

cards.title: UpperLevel Lab (WL 119)
cards.subtitle: Woods Laboratory, Room 119
cards.notes: Choose this smaller lab when you need an iMac-based technical setup; coordinate access with the Computer Science Program before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A six-computer upper-level computer-science lab with iMac workstations.
cards.evidence_claim: Sewanee identifies Woods Laboratory 119 as the UpperLevel Lab and lists six 27-inch iMac workstations.
cards.access_notes: A Computer Science Program space; verify current lab access and any course-related restrictions before use.

cards.title: Hamilton Hall Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Hamilton Hall, School of Theology
cards.notes: Use the reading room for reserve or reference consultation in Hamilton Hall; confirm building access with the School of Theology before visiting.
cards.short_summary: A foyer reading room with permanent course reserves and a reference collection.
cards.evidence_claim: Sewanee states that Hamilton Hall’s reading room provides permanent course reserves and a reference collection for students and faculty.
cards.access_notes: Hamilton Hall serves the School of Theology; confirm current building and collection access before planning a visit.
